headline: A law renames a Cincinnati, Ohio Postal Service facility after two local men, John H. Leahr and Herbert M. Heilbrun.
what_it_does: This law officially names the United States Postal Service building at 3493 Burnet Avenue in Cincinnati, Ohio, as the John H. Leahr and Herbert M. Heilbrun Post Office. It changes only the name of the building. It does not change postal services, hours, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on March 11, 2022.
